mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM todo_item t WHERE t.enterprise_id = #{args[0]} AND t.status IN ('pending', 'in_progress') AND t.team_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM enterprise_team_member m WHERE m.enterprise_id = t.enterprise_id AND m.team_id = t.team_id AND m.user_id = t.owner_user_id)
